findings.note: Game preview: Spoelstra moved Wiggins to the bench and started Pelle Larsson instead, and in his first game off the bench Wiggins scored 6 points on 2-of-6 shooting in 32 minutes. Utah is injury-depleted and has lost eight straight, which could help the Over.

In the Oct. 21 season opener, Wiggins started and scored 11 points on 5-of-11 shooting in 27 minutes while all five Heat starters reached double figures. That suggests he gets fewer shots next to Giannis Antetokounmpo than he did last season, when he averaged 15.4 points.
